key_finding: If the dark sector has a false vacuum, the decay rate depends strongly on the dark Higgs quartic lambda_Hd. For lambda_Hd ~ 0.1-1 (similar to SM), the bounce action B ~ 25-250, giving half-life from ~10^(-30) to 10^(+15) age of universe. The dark vacuum is MARGINALLY stable for typical SIDM parameters. A portal coupling epsilon > 10^-3 would significantly shorten the lifetime.
